searchLog.outcome: Read the publisher PDF and author article. Set a Southern British, non-rhotic reference and distinguish traditional phonemic labels from modern surface realization.

searchLog.query: Collins British English entries for every selected word; follow up ambiguous homographic sections and vowel variants
searchLog.outcome: Consulted primary dictionary pages for 160 selected ordinary words. Selected citation forms, normalized only /r/ to /ɹ/ and glyph g to ɡ, retained British /əʊ/, /ɒ/, /ɜː/ and length marks. DRESS /ɛ/ follows Collins, with the older /e/ convention disclosed. Room’s competing FOOT/GOOSE variants excluded; pre-/l/ words form their own context.

searchLog.query: Accent-specific counterpart coverage and source-provenance audit
searchLog.outcome: Added 20 units, leaving the existing British KIT/FLEECE and THOUGHT/LOT units untouched. Word pools are dictionary-curated; no word is labelled as a recovered study stimulus. No dialect is treated as universally British.

searchLog.query: Primary RP corpus evidence for GOOSE-fronting before dark /l/
searchLog.outcome: Consulted the 2023 publisher study and recorded its separate dark-/l/ context analysis. The 2/2 pre-/l/ subgroup remains separate from the five-per-side pre-obstruent core.
